snippet.title: Claude AI Se Video Editing | Talking Video to Motion Graphics (Urdu/Hindi)
snippet.description:
Claude AI se talking video ko motion graphics ke saath edit karne ka practical workflow — Urdu/Hindi mein, real screen recordings aur finished example ke saath.

Is tutorial mein ChatGPT se visual plan banayenge, Claude mein editing instructions aur source files upload karenge, phir exported video ko review karenge. Final example bhi poora dikhaya gaya hai.

CHAPTERS
0:00 Claude se video editing
0:25 ChatGPT mein visual plan
1:09 Equivalent editing workflow
1:32 Claude: model, skill aur source files
2:02 Editing instructions submit karein
2:21 Preview, export aur file check
3:06 Finished example: full playback
3:56 Publish karne se pehle review

AI workflows aur practical tutorials: https://withhammad.com/
Aise hands-on tutorials ke liye subscribe karein.

Production note: Presented with my AI avatar and cloned voice. Screen recordings show the real workflow. The reference creator's private editing skill was unavailable, so this tutorial demonstrates an equivalent workflow with original narration and fresh recordings. Results and processing time depend on the tools and source footage.
Workflow reference: https://youtu.be/HYbRdc_3_LQ

#ClaudeAI #VideoEditing #AITutorial

plan.expect: 200 OK + Location: session URI, saved to state_path before any bytes are sent

plan.url: <session URI from the Location header of step 1>
plan.expect: 201 Created + video resource; id saved to state_path at once
200 + thumbnail URLs; sha256 saved to state_path. A failure is a warning, not a failed publish (403: verify the channel at https://www.youtube.com/verify).

notes: Only the OAuth token refresh (POST to oauth2.googleapis.com, creates nothing) and GETs were sent. Run with dry_run=False and a state_path to upload.
